card.name: Small numbers before time units
card.fires_on: A small number (1, 2, 3) or "few" that begins a time span or age range, right before a unit like weeks, days, months or years. Seen in onset ranges and pediatric age ranges.

modes.label: Onset range
modes.description: A starting number in a time-to-onset or duration range.

modes.label: Pediatric age range
modes.description: The lower age bound in a patient age range, often in weeks or months.
modes.example: pediatric patients aged <<1>> month to 12 years were enrolled

card.writes: It promotes time-unit words such as week, month and day, so the model predicts a time unit next.
card.plain: It spots a small number that starts a time span and predicts that weeks, days or months come next.
